candidate_evidence.quote: autologous peripheral blood T cells lentivirally transduced to express a dual-target, truncated IL7Ra modified chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with history of glioblastoma are diagnosed with recurrent glioblastoma and residual tumor after intracranial tumor resection/biopsy performed in Beijing Tiantan Hospital.

agents.agent_name_registered: Inverse correlated dual-target, truncated IL7Ra modified CAR -expressing autologous T-lymphocytes.

role_evidence.quote: Intratumoral or intraventricular administration via Ommaya reservoir.

source_quote.quote: also evaluate the degree of target expression, biological characteristics of samples at diagnosis versus at recurrence or progression

coder_notes: CAR-T cell therapy is an excluded intervention type, so no candidate. The record plans CSF/blood CAR-T pharmacokinetics (qPCR) and cytokine pharmacodynamics, but because there is no candidate agent tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned are coded no under the manual wording; adjudicator may wish to note the CSF PK plan.
